deals.comment: LOEN Entertainment, Inc. (KOSDAQ:A016170) acquired Story Plant Co.,Ltd. from CJ E&M Corporation (KOSDAQ:A130960) for KRW 100 million on May 12, 2017. Under the terms, 0.2 million shares were acquired at KRW 500 per share.

Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) agreed to acquire remaining 70% stake in J Wide Company for KRW 6 billion on December 26, 2018. Under the transaction, Kakao Corp. acquires 0.07 million shares. The transaction has been resolved by the Board of Directors of Kakao Corp. The transaction is expected to complete on December 26, 2018.

Jiho Shin and other shareholders acquired 70% stake in Widescompany from J Wide Company Co., Ltd. for KRW 35 million on May 30, 2019. Under the terms, Jiho Shin acquired additional 4000 shares at a price of KRW 0.005 million accounting for 40% stake in Widescompany and other shareholders acquired 3000 shares at a price of KRW 0.005 million accounting for 30% stake in Widescompany.

deals.sellers: Spackman Equities Limited; Zip Cinema (HK) Limited
deals.comment: An unknown buyer signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Zip Cinema Co., Ltd. from Spackman Entertainment Group Limited (Catalist:40E) on July 7, 2020. Under the plan, the buyer will acquire 0.02 million common shares of Zip Cinema. The consideration of the transaction shall be negotiated and agreed upon between the Purchaser and the Spackman, subject to the relevant regulations and necessary approvals by the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited and the Korea Exchange, and the Parties’ respective shareholders, where applicable. Kakao Entertainment Corp., entered into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire Zip Cinema Co., Ltd., from Spackman Equities Limited and Zip Cinema (HK) Limited for KRW 17.9 billion on September 14, 2021. Pursuant to the terms of the agreement, Kakao Entertainment Corp., shall acquire a total of around 0.01679 million shares, where Spackman Equities Limited would be selling 0.015614 million shares, representing around 92.9% stake, whereas Zip Cinema (HK) Limited would be selling 0.001176 million shares representing around 7% stake in Zip Cinema Co., Ltd. Kakao Entertainment Corp., shall pay to Zip HK a deposit of KRW 2.7 billion (the “Deposit”) within five business days from written notice duly given to Kakao Entertainment Corp., by Spackman Equities Limited and Zip Cinema (HK) Limited and Spackman Entertainment Group Limited (in the prescribed form as set out in the SPA, confirming that the SGX-ST has granted in-principle approval for the draft circular to be dispatched by Spackman Entertainment Group Limited to the Shareholders in respect of the Proposed Disposal and to convene the EGM), by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the relevant bank account(s) opened in the name of Zip HK (the “Spackman Equities Limited and Zip Cinema (HK) Limited Accounts”). At the completion of the sale and purchase of the sale shares in accordance with the SPA (the “Closing”), Kakao Entertainment Corp., shall pay to Zip HK the relevant purchase price allocated to it (being the aggregate of KRW 16.7 billion), less the Deposit, the Zip HK Holdback Amount (the “Balance Payment”) and, if applicable, the applicable capital gains tax and securities transaction tax for the Sale Shares, by wire transfer of immediately available funds, to the relevant Spackman Equities Limited and Zip Cinema (HK) Limited Account(s). The transaction is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement. The definitive agreement is expected to be executed on or before December 31, 2020. The transaction is also subject to regulatory approvals, approvals from Spackman Equities Limited and Zip Cinema (HK) Limited board, shareholder and lenders, resignation of Yoo Jin Lee as the current representative director, dividend distribution, registration intellectual property. The transaction is approved by the Board of Spackman. As of October 19, 2021, Spackman Entertainment Group Limited shareholders approved the transaction. Spackman Entertainment Group Limited intends to use the proceeds in production/investments of film projects, acquisition/investment of new business, repayment of borrowings, share buyback, payment of tax related to disposal of zip and working capital. Jangho Myung of Charm Accounting Corporation acted as accountant for Kakao Entertainment Corp.

Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) acquired remaining 40% stake in E&T Story Entertainment Co., Ltd. from Park, Chan Woo for KRW 300 million on December 31, 2020. Under the terms, Kakao Corp. acquired 0.02 million shares at KRW 15,000 per share.
